name: Corn and Oil
preparation: Add rum and falernum to a rocks glass with ice.
Squeeze lime and drop shell into the glass.

name: Airmail
preparation: Shake rum, lime, and honey syrup with ice.
Strain into a Collins glass over ice.
Top with chilled champagne and garnish.

name: Taboo
preparation: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice until smooth.
Garnish with mint and grated nutmeg.

name: Donn Beach Grog
preparation: Blend rums, juices, honey, and pimento dram with crushed ice.
Pour into a tiki mug and top with a splash of soda.

name: Eastern Standard
preparation: Gently muddle mint with syrup and lime in a shaker.
Add bourbon and ice; shake well.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with mint.

name: Pimm's Cup
preparation: Fill a Collins glass with ice.
Add Pimm's and top with chilled lemonade.
Garnish with cucumber, fruit, and mint.

name: Paradise
preparation: Express orange twist over the drink.

name: Dubonnet Cocktail
preparation: Stir gin and Dubonnet-style aromatized wine with ice.
Express orange twist; note house Dubonnet rouge when available.

name: Morning Glory Fizz
preparation: Dry-shake scotch, citrus, syrup, and egg white.
Add ice and shake again; rinse glass with absinthe.
Strain into a Collins glass and top with soda.

name: Vermouth Cassis
preparation: Build vermouth and cassis over ice in a wine glass.
Stir gently and garnish with lemon twist.

name: Whiskey Rickey
preparation: Add whiskey and lime juice to a highball glass with ice.
Top with chilled soda and stir once.

name: Harvard
preparation: Stir cognac, vermouth, and bitters with ice.

name: Horse's Neck
preparation: Build bourbon and bitters over ice in a highball.
Drape lemon peel over the rim.

name: Kir
preparation: Add cassis to a wine glass.
Top with chilled white wine and stir gently.

name: Coffee Cocktail
preparation: Shake all ingredients vigorously with ice.

name: Blue Blazer
preparation: Warm scotch, syrup, and water; ignite carefully if performing the classic toss.
Pour between preheated mugs to mix.
Serve hot with lemon twist; skip flames for home service.

name: Cooperstown
preparation: Stir gin, vermouth, and bitters with ice.

name: Milk Punch
preparation: Shake brandy, milk, and syrups with ice.
Grate nutmeg; clarify for bottled service if desired.

name: Left Bank
preparation: Shake gin, elderflower, and lemon with ice.
Float or stir in chilled wine; garnish.

name: London Sour
preparation: Shake gin, citrus, triple sec, and syrup with ice.

name: Luau Grog
preparation: Top with splash of soda; garnish.

name: Honolulu Cooler
preparation: Shake gin, juices, and syrup with ice.

name: Havana Cooler
preparation: Muddle mint with syrup and lime in glass.
Add rum and ice; top with soda.

name: White Sangria
preparation: Build in a pitcher with fruit.

name: Jamaican Mule
preparation: Build rum and lime over ice in a mug.

name: Knickerbocker
preparation: Strain into a wine glass over crushed ice.

name: Mojito Cubano
preparation: Muddle mint with syrup and lime.

name: Port O' Call
preparation: Strain over crushed ice in a mug.

name: Rose
preparation: Garnish; apple brandy stands in for kirsch in inventory mapping.

name: Sbagliato
preparation: Build Campari and sweet vermouth over ice in a wine glass.

name: Dry Martini
preparation: Stir gin and vermouth with ice until very cold.
Garnish with lemon twist or olive.

name: London Fog
preparation: Shake gin, tea, syrups, and cream with ice.

name: Mimosa
preparation: Pour orange juice into a flute.
Garnish lightly; do not stir aggressively.
